---
title: "First 90-day review"
---

**Pause point:** Near the end of the first 90 days, before treating the initial plan as the working basis for candidature.

**Prevents:** Quietly carrying weak assumptions, unclear roles or an unworkable project into the next phase.

**Use:** Do-confirm.

## Critical checks

- [ ] Supervisory roles, meeting cadence, decision records and feedback expectations are working in practice.
- [ ] The next formal milestone and its evidence requirements have been confirmed from a current official source.
- [ ] The research problem, provisional question and intended contribution can be stated plainly and are not being confused with a broad topic.
- [ ] The main feasibility assumptions have been tested rather than merely asserted.
- [ ] The literature-search approach is broad enough to find relevant concepts, methods and contrary evidence, and its limits are recorded.
- [ ] File storage, decision records, data planning and backup recovery have been tested.
- [ ] Ethics, governance, access, safety, skills and specialist-support dependencies have named owners and realistic lead times.
- [ ] The next 90 days are expressed as a small set of outcomes with evidence of completion, not a long activity list.
- [ ] Unresolved risks and disagreements have an owner, next action and review date.

## Stop condition

Pause any major commitment if the central question, feasibility, necessary access or approval pathway remains materially unclear.

## Evidence to retain

Keep the reviewed project statement, feasibility notes, search record, decision log, risk register, next-phase outcomes and supervisor comments or approval.

::: {.callout-warning title="Check locally"}
This review complements, but does not replace, formal confirmation or progress milestones.
:::
